## BF16 decode steps at matched batch sizes: TensorRT-LLM 1.4.0rc2 vs vLLM v0.30.0

Pure-decode steps only, ms per step (step start to next step start). T = TensorRT-LLM (71e2c32c; batch 1 from smoke d35e631b), V = vLLM (14d959e5), same g6e.xlarge type, BF16 weights and KV. Attention includes RoPE and KV-cache writes; normalization kernels are `other` in both. Context lengths are not in the step labels: the 1k-1k windows are closed loops whose requests start together, so their contexts depend on where in the requests' life each window fell; the chat windows are open-loop steady states at near-equal load, the fairest pairing.
